social_media.headline: Warning-Level Space Weather Event Has Ended
social_media.subheadline: Conditions have decreased to lower-level concern
social_media.summary: G3–G5 geomagnetic storm conditions have ended. G1–G2 activity and elevated solar particle levels may continue as the event subsides.

confidence.label: Status
confidence.detail: Warning is no longer in effect, return to routine monitoring.

what_we_know: Warning-level conditions officially ended 0600 UTC Monday.
Lower-level geomagnetic activity and elevated particle levels may continue.

footer.left: Return to normal monitoring as procedures allow.

visual.alt_text: Operational visualization indicating the warning-level space weather event has ended and residual activity is subsiding.
